## Is Xero connected?

Asks Xero which organisations this connection can see. It reads nothing
but the organisation name, calls no model, and writes nothing.

Connecting Xero is a one-off job in n8n's own credential screen, in
another window. The agent cannot do it, and cannot make Xero's sign-in
window appear. It can only say what it found and read out the steps.

The second probe checks the optional `Xero (read-write)` credential,
which is only needed to prepare transactions for the user to click OK on.
